paper_metadata.title: Development of lightweight Al-based entropy alloys for elevated temperature applications

evidence.quote: A series of lightweight Al-based entropy alloys containing Cu, Zn, Cr, V, Ti and Fe has been designed for elevated temperature applications.
The six alloys were prepared by mixing the corresponding pure elements in a graphite crucible

The molten metal was finally cast into a copper permanent mold which was preheated at 250 °C. The produced ingots were then air-cooled down
the as-cast samples were exposed to 300 °C for 100 h
the as-cast samples of Alloy 5 were exposed to 350 °C, 400 °C, and 450 °C for 100 h
All six alloys exhibited multiphase features with three to four different phases
